Same team, same process, aimed at problems we deal with ourselves. Codaze is the first one.

In design · Launch prep for 2027

Codaze

Co-parenting runs on the calendar.

Codaze puts the schedule at the center: whose week it is, what's coming up, and what changed. Plan handoffs, start a swap, and keep a record you both trust. Designed by a parent who lives the handoffs.

From first sketch to shipped code.

Hire us for one piece or the whole build. Design and engineering stay in the same hands, so what ships is what you approved.

  • Decide what's worth building before the money goes in. We pressure-test the idea and frame a direction your team can commit to. Includes Blue Sky Design, our framework for future-facing product work.

    • Discovery workshops
    • Concept validation
    • Roadmap framing
    • Blue Sky Design

  • Identities and websites that look like who you are and turn visitors into calls, bookings, and sales. Built in Next.js and managed in a CMS your team can run.

    • Brand identity
    • Interface design
    • Next.js / React
    • CMS setup
    • AI-assisted features

  • Research and design grounded in how your users behave. We test with real people, then build the system that keeps the product consistent as it grows.

    • User research
    • Information architecture
    • Prototyping & testing
    • Design systems
    • AI product UX

  • Show up when people nearby search for what you do, then measure what turns into business. Campaigns, landing pages, and reporting you can read in five minutes.

    • Local SEO
    • Google Ads
    • Landing pages
    • GA4 & reporting

Ways to work with us.

Every engagement is scoped to a fixed price before work starts. No hourly billing.

2 weeks

Strategy sprint

Pressure-test an idea before you invest in it. You leave with a clear direction, a prioritized plan, and a clickable concept.

6–12 weeks

Project

A brand, website, or product taken from kickoff to launch. Design and build in one team, with milestones you sign off on.

Monthly

Partnership

Design, engineering, and marketing on call each month. Most of our clients stay on this after launch.

How a project runs.

  1. Weeks 1–2

    Explore

    We map the vision and pressure-test the idea first, so we build the right thing.

  2. Weeks 2–4

    Design

    Brand, experience, and screens. You see the work as it takes shape.

  3. Weeks 4–10

    Build

    We engineer and ship it ourselves, so design and code stay matched.

  4. Launch & after

    Launch

    We get it live, then stay on. Most clients keep us after launch day.

Most projects run 6 to 12 weeks. Fixed fee, clear milestones.
